summary: All the damage visible in this kitchen matches what was recorded at move-in: worn cabinet trims, the pelmet gap, the cable, the failed sealant and the washing machine marks. You should not be charged for any of it. The only thing to sort out is clearing your belongings off the worktops, sink and floor and giving the surfaces and washing machine seal a good clean before you hand back the keys.
